searchText: For the gas, can we just update the client config in the json-rpc compact tests to set the same value on Nethermind? For blockValue, I don't know off the top of my head I think slotNumber it's probably not intentional, would have to double check. And I would have to double check but I think the mempool test is SpecOnly so it just has to match the format/fields, not perfect match the values. Yes, we can update the client config. Should that go directly in hive's client config, or in also forkenv.json? Since this only affects rpc-compat tests, forkenv.json seems like the right place. For blockValue, geth passes 0 for buildBlock tests [here](https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/master/miner/payload_building.go) so the generated fixtures all have 0. Oh and the mempool test doesn't have the speconly comment I think there's a client config file in the rpc-compat folder I'm afk but can look later. Thanks! Is there anything i can do here to help? Also `SlotNumber` issue seems to be because geth shares the same struct `ExecutableData` and doesn't omit when its null but that shouldn't exist for ExecutionPayloadV3 (pre glamsterdam) We can probably update it to omit null, we'll have to check if V4 can omit or it needs more changes on the geth side. I think If amsterdam is active then field shouldn't be null in first place so adding omitempty should be fine, I am not that familier with geth's codebase so probably you can confirm on that later.
